name: reverse_quarters
prompt: Use Q3 2025 as the reference. Express Q2 2025 revenue relative to that reference, including the absolute difference and the percentage with Q3 in the denominator.
expected: Primary Q2 2025, baseline Q3; signed difference and percentage use Q3.

name: gap_months
prompt: Compare April 2026 revenue against January 2026 revenue. Show the dollar change and growth percentage; do not include February or March.
expected: Primary April baseline January; no adjacency restriction or intervening data.

name: zero_baseline
prompt: Compare January 2026 revenue with January 1900. Show both totals, the absolute change, and the percentage change if it is mathematically defined.
expected: No historical sales baseline; total and absolute change preserved, percentage undefined.

name: annual_report
prompt: Prepare a Q2 2025 report against Q2 2024: revenue totals, monthly revenue and the top two products for Q2 2025, plus proposed actions for Q3 2025. Leave it unsaved.
expected: YoY calculation, current months/top2 and next-quarter actions; no save.

name: cancel_list
prompt: Withdraw the deletion I was about to confirm. After that, list my saved reports so I can check they are still there.
expected: Pending changes from one to zero, report retained and listed.

name: preview_cancel_list
prompt: First preview removal of reports whose title contains Keep me, then cancel that preview, and finally list my reports. Do not delete anything.
expected: Three ordered operations; final pending zero, no deleted reports or active preview.

name: save_help
prompt: Suppose next time I ask you to archive this report under a title: would it store the current draft, and who would be able to read it? I am only asking about the behavior.
expected: Explain explicit saving of current analysis and owner-only access; no mutation.

name: delete_help
prompt: How do I stop a proposed deletion, and does asking for a deletion preview already erase the report? Explain only; do not run anything.
expected: Explain cancellation, preview is non-destructive and exact confirmation; no state change.

name: percentile
prompt: For August 2025, calculate the 90th percentile of order value. Do not replace it with average order value.
expected: Specific unsupported percentile response; no unrelated profitability boilerplate or query.

name: long_months
prompt: I need one revenue row for each month from February 2021 through April 2025 inclusive. Keep all 51 months; do not group by year.
expected: Explain 50 monthly row limit, no truncation or substitute aggregation.
